difficulty_reason: The selected bound requires a new quantitative control of the mixed parallel/perpendicular term after symmetrizing a reversible Markov chain, rather than a direct application of a classical product-gap theorem. The authors construct weighted eigenvector factors for the cross term, carry them through a uniform quadratic minimization, and connect the resulting bound to the maximum one-step escape probability; this full new core is at native 1208–1345 and 1524–1677. Classical product-gap corollaries and the separate near-independence/permutation branches are supporting or unqualified context, not additional units.
